title: Extremal ranks of unlabeled multifurcating rooted trees in a bijective encoding by the positive integers
summary: Maranca and Rosenberg (2024) devised a ranking scheme for unlabeled multifurcating rooted trees, in which the trees are bijectively associated with the positive integers. Here, generalizing earlier results for bifurcating trees, we determine, for trees with a fixed number of leaves, which multifurcating trees obtain the maximal and minimal ranks.
